page.layout: One printed page. Left margin: four marginal notes in smaller type, beside the list. Main block: one column of names, four to a year group, with the years 1443 to 1449 in the right margin. Page number at the head.

l.note: Foedus civitat. Gron. cum Oestbroecste [?] a..is [?] Collumanis & eorum vicinis qui buidâ [?] in quo imprimis depto [?] ia potestate in iudicii [?] Item foedus eiusdem cum omnib. OSTERGOIS in quadriênium: idq; sepe prorogatum,
Pacta civitatis cum VVestreewoldiis perpetua. Forum maius Groningae iterni captum filicibus,

page.notes: The printed marginal notes are in a worn, small type. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "Oestbroecste" (the long-s form is uncertain), "a..is", "buidâ", "depto", and "potestate in iudicii". The left-margin notes are placed beside the names where they stand; their exact line alignment is approximate. The first note group's "Gron." is kept as printed. Name spellings such as "Folkeer" and "Folker", "Hindrick" and "Hinrick", and "Gosen" and "Gofen" are copied as printed. The year marks are as printed: 1443 to 1449, with 1445 and 1448 partly smudged. No catchword or signature appears on this page.
